The Atelier

Every tier, considered.

Cake Couture Kenya is built around a simple idea: a cake should feel as personal as the day it’s made for. Founder Phyllis Kariuki and her team design each cake from a one-to-one consultation — sugar flowers, hand-painted finishes, and sculptural tiers built to match a couple’s story rather than a catalogue.

The result is a portfolio spanning romantic wedding tiers, milestone celebration cakes, and heritage-inspired centrepieces — recognised in 2024 as Kenya’s Most Creative Ceremony Baker.
